verdict.rationale: A/B testing of subject lines or content is a fair question for an email marketing platform like Moosend. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions A/B or split testing, variants, or automatic winner selection. The closest items cover dynamic content, AI-powered suggestions and analytics dashboards, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
